quotations.old_english: Þ UNCERTAIN is án eádignes þe hí þǽr onfóþ, and ungelíc missenlicnes þæs edleánes
Seó missenlicnes (diversitas) manna líchamena . . . seó missenlicnes manna synna

source_text: missenlic-ness. Add :-- Þ UNCERTAIN is án eádignes þe hí þǽr onfóþ, and ungelíc missenlicnes þæs edleánes (dispar retributionis qualitas), Gr. D. 315, 24. Seó missenlicnes (diversitas) manna líchamena . . . seó missenlicnes manna synna, 333, 23.
